clock_mode_note: RR0-08 keeps latency on wall and counts on paused, and records both. Phase-fire offsets are a latency figure, so the protocol cell is wall. Paused runs are recorded beside it. The vc_scale_profile harness is not this measurement: it advances the mock clock 8s and does not read rvc_slot_phase_*.

lateness_definition: lateness_ms = observed_elapsed_ms - deadline_ms, except block, whose deadline 0 has already passed at the 600 ms wake, so lateness_ms = observed_elapsed_ms - 600. The [0, +50] bound is this lateness. The offset metric is the observed elapsed itself (about 600 for block, where a whole-second RED read is 0).
